decisions.reason: SCHEMA.md explicitly requires the well-definedness lemma to depend on the definition via deps and permits the reverse justified_by annotation. The current definition lists this lemma only in justified_by, never in deps. Its contractions are defined directly from smooth g, T and n; n.J=-mu and hJ=J-mu n follow by normalization. There is no prerequisite cycle and no edit is warranted.

Clause (d) compared the covariant bilinear restriction of T with the contravariant S defined by S^{ab}=h^a_c h^b_d T^{cd}. This was an ill-typed equality. The repair defines S-flat(v,w)=S(g(v,.),g(w,.)), with components g_ac g_bd S^{cd}, and proves equality on the rest space by contracting the unchanged decomposition with v_a w_b. Smoothness, symmetry, uniqueness and all component signs are preserved; no physical or stronger choice premise is introduced.

Clause (a) and fact L6 obtained h from a definition requiring a tensor T, although no T occurs in the kinematic hypotheses. The repair uses h_p=h_{n_p}, v mapped to v+g_p(n_p,v)n_p, from the earlier observer definition and removes the unused tensor-dependent prerequisite. The normalization derivative still proves spatiality; the pullback-curve identity is now restricted to gamma-prime=n composed with gamma, avoiding an incorrect assertion for arbitrary curve sections. The scalar product rule is sourced to the induced derivative on functions.

The original data supplied only (R^4,g) and a coordinate orientation; a future observer requires a timelike field N and g(n,N)<0. Chart orientation supplies neither. The repair chooses the smooth time orientation N=partial_0 in the refuted formulation and counterexample data, checks g(N,N)=-1 and g(n,N)=-1 for n=N, and keeps the same tensor T_00=-E_0[1+(x^1/L_0)^2]. Constant Christoffels and partial_0 varphi=0 give zero divergence while mu=-varphi<0. No matter realization, field-law solution or measurement is asserted.

The normal-coordinate theorem explicitly asserts only Gamma(p)=0, partial g(p)=0 and g(p)=eta; its scope remark explicitly disclaims curvature and second-derivative claims. The old attribution was unsupported. The repair separates these statements from the curvature tensor R(X,Y)Z defined by the connection commutator, cites its actual tensoriality supplier, and explains why nonzero R_p cannot have all components zero in any basis. No gravitational-energy no-go theorem follows or is asserted. Also repaired the digest-confirmed misattribution excluding noncompact domains: local smooth fields on noncompact U are allowed; unbounded integrals/asymptotic limits need convergence assumptions beyond finite-chain Stokes.

The old scope bullet excluded noncompact regions even though the model definitions allow arbitrary nonempty open smooth domains and finite-chain Stokes limits the chains, not the ambient space. The repair explicitly permits noncompact smooth U, restricts only flux integration to finite smooth singular chains, and separately defers nonsmooth interfaces, distributional sources, unbounded slice integration and asymptotic limits needing further convergence/boundary hypotheses. All local and finite-chain predictions, SI readings, normalization and empirical qualifications are retained.
